prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photoreal luxury fashion editorial of an adult woman in a dark black studio. She stands in a graceful full-body pose with one arm raised and the other bent near her head, wearing a white form-fitting halter fashion top with a draped fitted white skirt and minimal earrings. Use low-key studio lighting combined with long-exposure light painting: flowing amber and golden-orange luminous trails wrap around the figure in vertical organic waves, with directional highlights shaping the fashion silhouette. Keep the subject sharply focused, the light trails controlled, the black negative space deep, and the mood sculptural, cinematic, mysterious, and elegant.
